confirmed_data_archetype: Incident-centric structured event records with repeated metric measurements per source incident. Suitable for limited descriptive comparative analysis; not an established representative time-series or predictive dataset.

tracks.name: Comparative Intelligence
supporting_evidence: 30 incidents contain both downtime_minutes and failure_frequency measurements.
4 machines, 4 root-cause categories and 3 shifts are represented.
The canonical dataset supports deterministic group totals, averages, rankings, percentage contributions and performance-gap calculations.
A simple descriptive baseline can be calculated directly from the canonical dataset.
missing_requirements: All 30 available incidents are synthetic and do not establish real-world operational representativeness.
The dataset does not establish an independently verified real operational population.
Small groups may produce unstable rankings and must be reviewed using minimum group-size and sensitivity checks.
Results must not be generalized as actual operational performance without representative real-world data.
tracks.recommendation: Approve Comparative Intelligence only for a clearly labelled synthetic-data analytical demonstration. Use deterministic incident-level aggregation, define minimum group sizes, validate selected calculations independently, review ranking stability and document all limitations.

tracks.name: Trend Intelligence
supporting_evidence: 30 incidents are available, but the observation window is limited.
missing_requirements: A sufficiently long and meaningful longitudinal observation period.
Evidence supporting trend or seasonality interpretation.
tracks.recommendation: Reject trend and seasonality conclusions for the current dataset. Do not infer long-term trends from the available synthetic incident period.

tracks.name: Risk and Priority Intelligence
supporting_evidence: Severity, shift, machine and root-cause attributes are available.
Downtime and failure-frequency measurements could support a transparent deterministic demonstration score.
missing_requirements: Evidence that the selected factors represent real urgency.
tracks.recommendation: Do not use Risk and Priority Intelligence as the primary track unless Post #2 explicitly approves a deterministic priority method with documented factors, thresholds and weights.

tracks.name: Anomaly Intelligence
supporting_evidence: Numerical downtime and failure-frequency values are available.
missing_requirements: Adequate historical observations to characterize variation.
Evidence distinguishing genuine anomalies from sample sparsity.
tracks.recommendation: Reject anomaly detection. The available synthetic sample does not establish a sufficiently defensible normal baseline.

tracks.name: Segmentation Intelligence
missing_requirements: Sufficient records for stable and meaningful segments.
Business evidence supporting interpretation of generated groups.
tracks.recommendation: Do not create or claim stable operational segments from the current synthetic dataset.

tracks.name: Predictive Intelligence
supporting_evidence: Numerical measurements are available for each source incident.
missing_requirements: Appropriate performance metrics and error analysis.
tracks.recommendation: Reject predictive modelling. The current dataset is not approved for predictive intelligence.

tracks.name: Simulation and Scenario Intelligence
supporting_evidence: Recorded measurements provide descriptive context only.
missing_requirements: Evidence supporting interpretation of simulated outputs.
tracks.recommendation: Reject operational simulation. Do not invent calibrated scenario parameters from the synthetic sample.

tracks.name: Text and Theme Intelligence
supporting_evidence: Text can be manually reviewed with record-level evidence.
missing_requirements: A larger and more diverse operational text corpus.
A validated taxonomy or theme-classification approach.
tracks.recommendation: Allow only controlled exploratory text review as an optional supporting activity. Do not claim generalized theme prevalence.

optional_supporting_track: H - Text and Theme Intelligence, limited to controlled exploratory review.
primary_analytical_question: Which recorded root-cause categories, machines and shifts have the highest observed downtime totals and failure-frequency values within the approved synthetic incident dataset?
decision_supported: Identify the highest-observed groups for closer descriptive review within the synthetic downtime investigation demonstration.
scope_boundary: Track A is approved only for reproducible descriptive comparison of the approved canonical synthetic dataset. Results must be labelled synthetic demonstration outputs and must not be presented as representative of real-world operations.
overall_readiness: DATA READY FOR ANALYTICAL TRACK DEVELOPMENT — TRACK A COMPARATIVE INTELLIGENCE.
readiness_explanation: The approved canonical synthetic dataset supports Track A (Comparative Intelligence) for a limited, reproducible and clearly labelled synthetic-data demonstration. The approval does not establish real-world operational representativeness and does not support predictive, anomaly, trend, segmentation or simulation claims.
post_3_approval_gate: Proceed to Post #3 only if the Post #2 reviewer accepts this limited Track A scope and approves the readiness evidence.
